skill.name: frontend-design
skill.description: Create distinctive, production-grade frontend interfaces with high design quality. Use this skill when the user asks to build web components, pages, artifacts, posters, or applications (examples include websites, landing pages, dashboards, React components, HTML/CSS layouts, or when styling/beautifying any web UI). Generates creative, polished code and UI design that avoids generic AI aesthetics.
skill.summary: Build distinctive, production-grade frontend interfaces with strong visual direction and working implementation guidance.
skill.author: ZhanlinCui

content.value_statement: Generic web interfaces can feel unfinished and forgettable. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code toward polished frontend work with clear visual direction.
actual_capabilities: Guides selection of a clear visual concept before implementation.
Supports pages, dashboards, components, posters, and web applications.
Provides direction for typography, color, motion, layout, and backgrounds.
Encourages working HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, or Vue output.
Adapts implementation complexity to minimalist or maximalist design goals.
limitations: It provides design and implementation guidance, not finished assets by itself.
External fonts, images, and motion libraries must be available in the target project.
Accessibility, performance, and browser support still need project-specific testing.
It may need extra constraints for strict brand systems or regulated products.

use_cases.title: Create a Launch Page
use_cases.description: Turn a product brief into a memorable landing page with distinctive layout, typography, color, and motion direction.

use_cases.title: Refresh an Existing Interface
use_cases.description: Improve a plain dashboard or app screen with stronger hierarchy, spacing, interaction states, and visual identity.

use_cases.title: Prototype a Visual Direction
use_cases.description: Explore bold aesthetic options for a campaign, internal tool, or client presentation before committing to production work.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Simple Page
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a single page.
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a one-page website for a small bakery. Use HTML and CSS. Make it polished, distinctive, and easy to scan.

prompt_templates.title: Improve an Existing Screen
prompt_templates.prompt: Redesign this dashboard screen. Keep the same information. Improve hierarchy, typography, color, spacing, and interaction states.

prompt_templates.title: Create a React Interface
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a React component for a music analytics dashboard. Choose a strong visual concept. Include responsive layout, states, and motion details.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Complete Visual System
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for a cohesive product surface.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design and implement a frontend for a research workflow app. Define the aesthetic direction, core screens, reusable patterns, and responsive behavior.

output_examples.input: Create a landing page for a climate data startup.
output_examples.output: A polished page concept with scientific typography, restrained color, clear sections, responsive structure, and purposeful motion cues.

output: Sharper information hierarchy and denser scan paths.
More deliberate colors, spacing, and table states.
A working frontend direction suitable for repeated use.

output_examples.input: Prototype a portfolio homepage for an illustrator.
output_examples.output: A characterful visual direction with expressive typography, gallery-focused layout, custom details, and responsive behavior.

best_practices: Provide the audience, product goal, required framework, and brand constraints.
Ask for working implementation details when you need usable frontend code.
Review accessibility, responsiveness, and performance after the first generated version.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for a generic beautiful page without context or audience.
Do not rely on this skill as a replacement for product requirements.
Do not skip testing when animations, fonts, or responsive layouts are added.

faq.question: What does this skill help create?
faq.answer: It helps create distinctive frontend pages, components, dashboards, posters, and web applications with working implementation guidance.

faq.question: Does it generate production code?
faq.answer: It asks the assistant to produce working frontend code when the user requests implementation.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Can it follow an existing brand system?
faq.answer: Yes, but you should provide brand colors, fonts, spacing rules, and examples.

faq.question: Does it include accessibility checks?
faq.answer: It mentions accessibility as a constraint, but final compliance still needs project-specific review.

faq.question: Is it only for React?
faq.answer: No. It can guide HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, Vue, and similar frontend work.
